title: Lingdan-V2: Large language models for clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine
abstract: arXiv:2610.14705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models have advanced medical reasoning, but clinically grounded reasoning in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) remains challenging because prescription decisions require integrating domain knowledge, syndrome differentiation, treatment principles, herbal prescription composition, and dosage determination. We develop a TCM language model family comprising models with 4 billion, 8 billion, and 14 billion parameters. The artificial intelligence contribution is a staged clinical alignment framework integrating large scale continued pretraining on TCM and clinical records, complementary reasoning supervision, and prescription-centered reinforcement learning (RL). We further formulate herbal prescription generation as a structured RL problem with prescription-level feedback, enabling direct optimization of clinical decision outputs beyond knowledge reproduction and generic instruction following. translated_title: 灵丹-V2：面向中医临床落地推理的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型已经推动了医学推理的发展，但中医（TCM）的临床落地推理仍然具有挑战性，因为处方决策需要整合领域知识、辨证论治、治则治法、方剂组成以及剂量确定。我们开发了一个中医语言模型系列，包含40亿、80亿和140亿参数的模型。其人工智能贡献是一个分阶段临床对齐框架，该框架集成了在中医语料和临床记录上的大规模持续预训练、互补推理监督，以及以处方为中心的强化学习（RL）。我们进一步将中药处方生成形式化为一个具有处方级反馈的结构化强化学习问题，从而能够直接优化临床决策输出，超越单纯的知识复现和通用指令遵循。工程应用方面……
tldr: 该研究开发了灵丹-V2中医大语言模型系列（40亿至140亿参数），通过整合持续预训练、推理监督与处方级反馈强化学习的分阶段临床对齐框架，实现了对中医辨证论治和处方生成等临床决策输出的直接优化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the Lingdan-V2 family of traditional Chinese medicine language models (4B to 14B parameters), which employs a staged clinical alignment framework integrating continued pretraining, reasoning supervision, and prescription-level reinforcement learning to directly optimize clinical decision outputs such as syndrome differentiation and herbal prescription generation.
